aboutGame.title: What is Moadra?
paragraphs: Moadra is a dark sci-fi Metroidvania from Gloomsoft, set on Protea VI roughly 20,000 years after an extinction event. You explore an interconnected alien world, recover the lost Neera heritage, and confront the planet's buried secrets.

Movement is survival: roll, dodge, leap, wall jump, and sprint through hostile terrain while the scanner bot and X-ray vision expose hidden routes. Destroyed organisms drop Protoplasm, which you spend in organic chambers to trigger metamorphosis and evolve Moadra's weapons and abilities.

explore.title: Explore Moadra Wiki
explore.description: Eight focused Moadra guides cover the opening hours, Protoplasm upgrades, boss fights, exploration, combat, controls, PC specifications, and launch news.

modules.name: Moadra Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the first-hour routine for Protea VI: set up controls, test the movement kit, map the opening zone, and approach new enemies with patience.

highlights.detail: Check control and accessibility settings, then test attack, dodge, and jump timing in a safe room.
Learn the map legend, mark locked routes, and identify what a checkpoint looks like.
Fight one new enemy type at a time and watch its wind-up before committing to a second attempt.
Prioritize mobility and survivability upgrades early so bad fights are easier to escape.
Revisit marked ledges and sealed paths after each new traversal ability.

modules.name: Moadra Abilities and Upgrade Guide
modules.description: Understand the Protoplasm loop and choose upgrades that improve mobility, survivability, weapon damage, and traversal.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Mobility and survivability upgrades come first because escaping a bad fight beats trying to win it.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Weapon damage is the next step: shorter fights leave fewer chances to make a mistake.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Traversal and utility abilities open shortcuts and make backtracking across Protea VI faster.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Specialized tools are situational, but they answer specific threats and blocked routes.

modules.name: Moadra Boss Guide
modules.description: Prepare for multi-phase encounters with full resources, arena scans, readable telegraphs, and a controlled plan for phase transitions.

highlights.label: Scout
highlights.detail: Use a scout run to watch attack patterns without chasing damage.

highlights.label: Scan
highlights.detail: X-ray scan the arena for hazards, ledges, and safe zones before engaging.

highlights.label: Phases
highlights.detail: Create distance at each transition, learn the new pattern, then look for damage windows.

modules.name: Moadra Map and Secrets
modules.description: Read Protea VI like a puzzle by scanning rooms, checking suspicious surfaces, and returning with the traversal tools that turn dead ends into shortcuts.

highlights.label: Walls
highlights.detail: Test long blank walls with jumps and wall jumps for hidden vertical routes.

highlights.label: Ceilings
highlights.detail: Check ceiling corners and cracked surfaces for breakable passages.

highlights.label: Map Gaps
highlights.detail: Open the map after major rooms and investigate gaps between explored areas.

modules.name: Moadra Weapons and Combat Guide
modules.description: Build a reliable combat rhythm around spacing, telegraphs, ranged options, and the full movement kit instead of trading hits.

highlights.label: Spacing
highlights.detail: Fight in open rooms and keep roll, dodge, and wall-jump routes available.

highlights.label: Telegraph
highlights.detail: React to the wind-up rather than the strike, then punish the recovery.

highlights.label: Arsenal
highlights.detail: Use ranged and melee tools together instead of saving every option for a later boss.

modules.name: Moadra Controls and Settings
modules.description: Check input support, tune accessibility options, and set up the control scheme before precision platforming raises the cost of a missed input.

highlights.label: Input
highlights.detail: Xbox, DualSense, and DualShock gamepads are supported, with DualShock listed as USB only.

highlights.label: Text
highlights.detail: Adjustable text size and subtitle options keep scanner data and story dialogue readable.

highlights.label: QTE-free
highlights.detail: Enable the QTE-free option to remove quick-time-event inputs from the campaign.

highlights.label: Audio
highlights.detail: Use per-channel volume controls to keep enemy audio cues audible over music.

modules.name: Moadra System Requirements
modules.description: Compare the minimum and recommended PC specifications for Moadra, including Windows, memory, graphics, DirectX, and storage.

highlights.label: Min
highlights.detail: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit, a quad-core processor, 4 GB RAM, and a GTX 900-series card.

highlights.label: Rec
highlights.detail: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit, an Intel Core i3-8100, 8 GB RAM, and a GTX 970 4GB.

highlights.label: Deck
highlights.detail: Moadra is Steam Deck Verified and needs 9 GB of available storage on PC.

items.question: What is Moadra?
items.answer: Moadra is a dark sci-fi Metroidvania from Gloomsoft. It is set on Protea VI roughly 20,000 years after an extinction event and follows a search for lost Neera heritage through an interconnected alien world.

items.question: Which platforms can play Moadra?
items.answer: Moadra launched on October 22, 2026 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch, and PC through Steam.

items.question: How does progression work in Moadra?
items.answer: Destroyed organisms drop Protoplasm. Moadra absorbs it and spends it inside organic chambers to trigger metamorphosis, evolving weapons and abilities.

items.question: What does the scanner bot do in Moadra?
items.answer: The Moadra scanner bot uses X-ray vision to inspect creatures and terrain, reveal hidden paths, and help map explored areas of Protea VI.

items.question: Is Moadra a difficult game?
items.answer: Moadra is built around difficult, evasive combat and precision platforming. Its movement kit, accessibility settings, and upgrade loop give players tools to manage encounters.

items.question: Does Moadra have a demo?
items.answer: Yes. A free Moadra demo is available on Steam and was updated with the same improvements included in the launch build.
